slides.title: Motor Unit
slides.english_text:
Motor Unit
⚫ Skeletal muscle is organized into functional groups called motor units.
⚫ Motorunit:
⚫ consists of a group of muscle fibers that are innervated by the same motorneuron
⚫ From a few muscle fibers or up to 2000 muscle fibers
⚫ When a motor neuron is stimulated enough to cause a contraction, all muscle fibers innervated by that motor neuron contract
⚫ Action potential: the signal to contract that is transmitted from the motor neuron to the muscle
⚫ The action potential from a motor neuron reaches a muscle fiber at motorend plate (neuromuscular junction)

⚫ Tension in the muscle
⚫ Pain in the extremity

Proprioceptors
⚫ Proprioceptors
⚫ Mainsensory receptors in the musculoskeletal system
⚫ transform mechanical distortion in the muscle into the nerve impulses that enter the spinal cord & stimulate a motor response

⚫ Muscle spindle: found in belly of the muscle; responds to the change in muscle length or velocity of a muscle stretch
⚫ Golgi tendonorgan(GTO): found in muscle-tendon junction; responds to tension in the muscle
